description: This PHP source file defines the class Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo, which implements a cache handler for Smarty templates using a PDO-connected database table. It includes methods for fetching, saving, and deleting cache entries stored in a MySQL database, with specific SQL statements and table structure details.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo
classes.description: A cache resource handler for Smarty that stores cache files in a database table via PDO.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache handler with a PDO connection, table name, and optional database name.

methods.name: fillStatementsWithTableName
methods.description: Populates SQL statements with the actual table name.

methods.name: getFetchStatement
methods.description: Prepares a PDO statement to fetch cache data based on provided identifiers.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Retrieves cached content and modification time from the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores cache content into the database with expiration handling.

methods.name: inputContent
methods.description: Encodes content before saving to database (identity function here).

methods.name: outputContent
methods.description: Decodes content after retrieving from database (identity function here).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entries based on provided filters or clears entire cache.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the properly formatted table name, including database if specified.
